manifest.name: @p-jiangh/dsh-enhance
manifest.description: oh-my-zsh-style enhancement bundle for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-enhance): packaged skills, work-rule prompt guidance, an Enhance agent preset with a persistent deep-work prompt section, and a doctor tool — install and go

bundle.text:
# dsh-enhance bundle patch: the plugin install row, the four scoped-subagent agent presets, and the Enhance preset.
#
# GENERATED FILE — do not hand-edit. Rendered by
#   node scripts/sync-dsh-enhance-preset.mjs
# from prompts/agents/dsh-enhance.persona.md (plus the four scoped sub-personas)
# and the enhance-mode section source; tests/presets-pin.test.mjs pins it
# byte-for-byte.
#
# `name` MUST be the full package name, matching the upstream convention
# (base/web-app patches reference '@deepseek-ai/dsh-*'). The Cordis loader
# resolves this as a module specifier from the profile directory, so a bare
# `dsh-enhance` would fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND unless the profile also
# carried an extra alias dependency. The row `id` stays short — ids are what
# user patches target, names are what the loader imports.
#
# The `preset-*` rows are *declarative* presets: @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset
# registers `config` into ctx.agentPresets when the row activates. That service
# is declared by the dsh-web-app / desktop bundles, i.e. it exists on
# dsh >= 0.2.0 only; on an older CLI (whose preset mechanism is the retired
# directory scan) these rows resolve nowhere and stay inactive entries rather
# than breaking the profile.
#
# Why four extra presets: on dsh >= 0.2.1 @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent
# removed `persona` and `toolFilter`, so a scoped subagent's persona and tool
# surface can only live in an Agent Preset that the tool row names through
# `agentPreset`. Every registered preset is listed in the session roster, so
# `Scout` / `Librarian` / `Reviewer` / `Task` are visible compositions of
# their own — see docs/roles.md.
#
# `config.plugins` is the session's ENTIRE composition — there is no
# inheritance — so it restates the persona, the agent-instructions row the Web
# surface disables on the host plane, the tool plane (mirroring the shipped
# `standard` preset), the four scoped subagents, this bundle's plugin row, and
# the enhance-mode section row.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-enhance
      name: '@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance'

    - id: preset-enhance-scout
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-enhance-scout
        name: Scout
        description: Enhance 的只读侦察组合：subagent_scout 工具用它塑造子会话（read/glob/grep）。
        order: 11
        plugins:
        - id: persona
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
          config:
            prefix: |-
              你是只读探索智能体（scout）。快速摸清仓库结构与约定，输出带文件路径的事实清单（每文件的职责、关键模式），以压缩上下文形式交接给调用方。不做修改、不写代码、不执行有副作用的操作。

        - id: agent-instructions
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
          config:
            maxBytes: 65536

        - id: time-context
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'

        - id: tool-fs
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          config:
            read: true
            readImage: false
            write: false
            edit: false

        - id: tool-fs-search
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
          config:
            sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

        - id: compaction
          name: cordis:group
          group: true
          isolate:
            compaction: true
            toolResultPruner: true
          config:
            - id: compaction-basic
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'

            - id: command-compact
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'

            - id: tool-result-pruner
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
              config:
                thresholdChars: 8192
                headChars: 4096
                tailChars: 1024

    - id: preset-enhance-librarian
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-enhance-librarian
        name: Librarian
        description: Enhance 的查证组合：subagent_librarian 工具用它塑造子会话（read/glob/grep/web_search）。
        order: 12
        plugins:
        - id: persona
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
          config:
            prefix: |-
              你是查证外部智能体（librarian）。定位外部库/包的源码与文档，回答概念、实现、行为三类问题。本地优先：先查本地安装的源码与缓存；本地不足才用 web_search 检索。结论附来源路径或链接（以文件与工具输出为准，不凭上下文记忆），标注未覆盖的盲区。

        - id: agent-instructions
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
          config:
            maxBytes: 65536

        - id: time-context
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'

        - id: tool-fs
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          config:
            read: true
            readImage: false
            write: false
            edit: false

        - id: tool-fs-search
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
          config:
            sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

        - id: tool-web
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
          config:
            search: true
            fetch: false

        - id: compaction
          name: cordis:group
          group: true
          isolate:
            compaction: true
            toolResultPruner: true
          config:
            - id: compaction-basic
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'

            - id: command-compact
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'

            - id: tool-result-pruner
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
              config:
                thresholdChars: 8192
                headChars: 4096
                tailChars: 1024

    - id: preset-enhance-reviewer
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-enhance-reviewer
        name: Reviewer
        description: Enhance 的审查组合：subagent_reviewer 工具用它塑造子会话（read/glob/grep）。
        order: 13
        plugins:
        - id: persona
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
          config:
            prefix: |-
              你是审查专注的智能体。一切判断以实际代码为准：读 diff 与周边上下文、运行相关检查，把阻塞问题与建议分开。引用必须带确切文件与行号。做 PR 审查时使用 code-review 技能。安全审查时以证据支撑漏洞发现，只读核查、不臆断。

        - id: agent-instructions
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
          config:
            maxBytes: 65536

        - id: time-context
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'

        - id: tool-fs
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          config:
            read: true
            readImage: false
            write: false
            edit: false

        - id: tool-fs-search
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
          config:
            sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

        - id: compaction
          name: cordis:group
          group: true
          isolate:
            compaction: true
            toolResultPruner: true
          config:
            - id: compaction-basic
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'

            - id: command-compact
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'

            - id: tool-result-pruner
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
              config:
                thresholdChars: 8192
                headChars: 4096
                tailChars: 1024

    - id: preset-enhance-task
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-enhance-task
        name: Task
        description: Enhance 的执行组合：subagent_task 工具用它塑造子会话（read/glob/grep/write/edit/todo_write）。
        order: 14
        plugins:
        - id: persona
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
          config:
            prefix: |-
              你是通用执行智能体（task/worker）。被委派后超聚焦地按既定计划逐项实现：一次一个待办、保持测试全绿、每步验证。发现计划与文件事实冲突时停下说明，不自作主张偏离；排障时先复现、再定位根因、做最小修复、最后回归，假设必须有证据支撑；信息不足时提问，不猜。进度如实汇报。

        - id: agent-instructions
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
          config:
            maxBytes: 65536

        - id: time-context
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'

        - id: tool-fs
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          config:
            read: true
            readImage: false
            write: true
            edit: true

        - id: tool-fs-search
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
          config:
            sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

        - id: tool-todo
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
          config:
            allowParallelInProgress: true

        - id: compaction
          name: cordis:group
          group: true
          isolate:
            compaction: true
            toolResultPruner: true
          config:
            - id: compaction-basic
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'

            - id: command-compact
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'

            - id: tool-result-pruner
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
              config:
                thresholdChars: 8192
                headChars: 4096
                tailChars: 1024

    - id: preset-enhance
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: enhance
        name: Enhance
        description: 开箱即用的增强模式：常驻深度工作提示词段 + 工作纪律 + 打包技能 + 交付门卫，并按需编排 scout/librarian/reviewer/task 子代理。
        order: 5
        plugins:
        - id: dsh-enhance
          name: '@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance'

        - id: enhance-mode
          name: '@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance/enhance-mode'

        - id: persona
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
          config:
            prefix: |-
              你是「Enhance 模式」的工作智能体：dsh-enhance 插件的编排者 persona。一个能编排整套 dsh-enhance 能力的执行型主代理。这个会话已经装载了 dsh-enhance 插件的全部能力（work-rules、技能、doctor、boulder 工作追踪与写令牌、交付门卫、advisor 伴随审核；目标用原生 goal 工具），并且你可以通过 subagent 工具按需派出四个专职子代理来分担工作。不要在不需要时派子代理——能自己直接、经济地做完的就自己做；只有当下述子代理确实更合适时才派。
              
              ## 能力总览
              - 完成用户请求是首要责任。先理解真实意图，再按需规划，再小步实现并验证，如实汇报进度与风险。
              - 需要独立核查证据（代码、配置、测试）时，先读文件核实，不凭会话记忆臆断。
              - 使用 work-rules 段与 dsh_enhance_doctor 确认插件装配状态。
              - 对较大/非平凡任务，用 boulder/goal 工具建立工作项与会话目标，逐步提交。
              
              ## 可调用的专职子代理（subagent）
              当你判断某类工作应交给专职子代理时，调用对应的 subagent 工具：
              - `subagent_scout`（侦察）：映射仓库结构、盘点文件/模块、给出一份紧凑的工作区上下文（只读，用 read/glob/grep）。
              - `subagent_librarian`（查证）：定位外部依赖的源码与文档、核实事实（只读）。
              - `subagent_reviewer`（审查）：以实际代码为依据做代码审查，区分阻塞性意见与改进建议（只读）。
              - `subagent_task`（执行）：聚焦执行一个明确的小任务（可读写、跑命令、逐步完成）。
              
              每次派发时给子代理一个自包含、范围明确的任务说明；拿回结果后整合进主流程并继续。子代理只返回结论/证据，最终交付与质量由你负责。
              
              ## 协作纪律
              - 该派就派，不该派就别派：简单/只需已有上下文的活自己做。
              - 派发后核实子代理产出再采信，不盲信其"做完了"。
              - advisor 会在你每个回合结束后伴随审查你的增量并将建议注入回来；遇到有建设性的建议，评估后采纳或说明放弃理由。
              
              ## 通用工作动态
              - 动手前理解需求；需要清理时才清理；不臆测、不编造证据。
              - 小步验证，做完即验证，增量即提交（能委派则委派）。

        - id: agent-instructions
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
          config:
            maxBytes: 65536

        - id: time-context
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'

        - id: tool-bash
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
          disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'

        - id: tool-pwsh
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
          disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'

        - id: tool-fs
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'

        - id: tool-fs-search
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
          config:
            sampleOverCapGlobResults: false

        - id: tool-jobs
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'

        - id: skill-filesystem
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'

        - id: tool-skill
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'

        - id: command-goal
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'

        - id: tool-goal
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'

        - id: planning
          name: cordis:group
          group: true
          isolate:
            planMode: true
          config:
            - id: plan-mode
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
              config:
                section: |
                  You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                  Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                  The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                  Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                  Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                  When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.

        - id: compaction
          name: cordis:group
          group: true
          isolate:
            compaction: true
            toolResultPruner: true
          config:
            - id: compaction-basic
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'

            - id: command-compact
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'

            - id: tool-result-pruner
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
              config:
                thresholdChars: 8192
                headChars: 4096
                tailChars: 1024

        - id: delegation
          name: cordis:group
          group: true
          isolate:
            workflowEngine: true
          config:
            - id: tool-subagent-control
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'

            - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'

            - id: tool-subagent
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
              config:
                provider: spawn
                toolName: subagent

            - id: tool-subagent-fork
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
              config:
                provider: fork
                toolName: subagent_fork

            # dsh-enhance-scoped subagent: scout (composition: dsh-enhance-scout)
            - id: dsh-enhance-subagent-scout
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
              config:
                provider: spawn
                toolName: subagent_scout
                agentPreset: dsh-enhance-scout
            # dsh-enhance-scoped subagent: librarian (composition: dsh-enhance-librarian)
            - id: dsh-enhance-subagent-librarian
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
              config:
                provider: spawn
                toolName: subagent_librarian
                agentPreset: dsh-enhance-librarian
            # dsh-enhance-scoped subagent: reviewer (composition: dsh-enhance-reviewer)
            - id: dsh-enhance-subagent-reviewer
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
              config:
                provider: spawn
                toolName: subagent_reviewer
                agentPreset: dsh-enhance-reviewer
            # dsh-enhance-scoped subagent: task (composition: dsh-enhance-task)
            - id: dsh-enhance-subagent-task
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
              config:
                provider: spawn
                toolName: subagent_task
                agentPreset: dsh-enhance-task

            - id: workflow-ptc
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
              config:
                provider: spawn

            - id: tool-workflow
              name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'

        - id: tool-ask-user
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'

        - id: tool-todo
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
          config:
            allowParallelInProgress: true

        - id: tool-web
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
          config:
            fetch: false
            searchTimeoutMs: 60000

        - id: present
          name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'

readme.text:
[](https://github.com/P-JIANGH/dsh-enhance/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）的 oh-my-zsh 风格增强插件。一次安装即可获得：打包的技能、持久的 work-rules 提示词段、doctor 工具，以及不断增长的 v2 能力面：工作追踪（boulder + 写令牌；goal 用**原生**服务）、守卫 + delivery-gate 纪律、worktree、advisor 伴随审核运行时，以及一个把 scout / librarian / reviewer / task 作为子代理派发的编排预设 **Enhance**（id `enhance`）——它还常驻一段深度工作协议（enhance-mode）作为预设作用域内的系统提示词段。

本项目仅称为 **dsh-enhance**。

> English: [README.en.md](README.en.md).

| 能力 | 作用 | 关闭方式 |
|---|---|---|
| **打包技能**（`code-review`、`git-workflow`、`tdd`） | 随包内置的技能包，通过标准的 `skill` 工具暴露 | 始终开启 |
| **work-rules 段** | 常驻系统提示词段（`dsh-enhance/work-rules`），内容为通用工作纪律 | `workRules: ''` |
| **doctor 工具** | `dsh_enhance_doctor` 报告实时装配状态（已加载插件、已注册技能、生效配置），并给出可执行的下一步建议 | `doctorTool: false` |
| **人类指令**（`/doctor`、`/boulder`） | UI `/` 菜单里属于本包的入口：`/doctor` 复用同一份装配诊断，`/boulder` 显示工作追踪状态。结果只在 UI 渲染——**不进模型历史、不消耗 token** | `commands: false` |
| **守卫 + delivery-gate** | write-existing / path-traversal / bash-read 守卫、rules 注入器（只读 `.dsh-enhance/rules/`）、完成声明 delivery-gate：绑定 `verify` + **受保护文件 manifest（sha256 快照，改动即 `tampered`）**，原生 goal 未完成时判为进展汇报 | `guards: false` |
| **工作追踪** | boulder（CAS）+ 写令牌 + start-work / delivery-gate 钩子。**目标（goal）归原生**：`create_goal`/`get_goal`/`update_goal` + `dsh-goal-round-driver`（目标未完成自动续轮） | `workTracking: false` |
| **worktree** | `worktree_create/list/cleanup` 工具 + boulder 联动 | `worktree: false` |
| **增强模式段（enhance-mode）** | 一段深度工作协议，由本包以 `@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance/enhance-mode` 行贡献，**只挂在 Enhance 预设作用域内**：选了该预设的会话每个都常驻这段系统提示词；没选的会话完全看不到。没有关键词触发，也没有"退出模式"的动作 | 不在预设里，就不出现（`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `preset-enhance` 行） |

readme.text: 插件是 **profile 级 bundle**：profile 启动时挂载，**所有会话共享**，因此不需要选预设也已经生效（`dsh_enhance_doctor` 会报「插件已加载：是」）。能力分三层落地，先分清哪一层在哪儿看得见：

readme.section: 如何体验（装完之后你会看到什么）
readme.text:
| 你看到的 | 怎么触发 | 需要什么 |
|---|---|---|

需要 `dsh` CLI（npm：`@deepseek-ai/dsh`）。**把命令里的 `<your-profile>` 换成你实际在跑的那个 profile**：桌面端 GUI 用 `desktop`，loopback Web 用 `web`，无头用 `headless`。

readme.text:
> **profile 名写错的后果（值得先看一眼）**：`dsh plugin` 在 profile 不存在时会**静默新建**一个（无报错）。所以把示例名照抄成 `dsh-enhance` 会真的建出这个 profile——插件"装上了"，但桌面端加载的是 `desktop`，**你在界面上什么也看不到**。先确认名字：`ls $DSH_HOME/profiles`（默认 `~/.dsh/profiles`）。
>
> **桌面端的 profile 由应用独占管理**：`dsh --profile desktop …` 会被拒绝（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。给 GUI 装插件要在**应用的插件面板**里做；CLI 只管 `web` / `headless` / 自建 profile。yaml
> allowBuilds:
>   "@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance@git+https://github.com/P-JIANGH/dsh-enhance.git#<commit>": true
> ```
> 嫌麻烦就用第 1 种（tarball 里已经带了构建产物 `lib/`）。
>
> **网络**：部分网络环境直连 `github.com` 不通。git 可按 URL 定向设代理（只影响 GitHub）：`git config --global http.https://github.com.proxy http://127.0.0.1:10809`；pnpm 拉 tarball 则认 `HTTPS_PROXY` 环境变量。
sh
dsh --profile <your-profile> --dump-config   # 找 "# == " 层头；层头用的是 profile 记录的 bundle 名（新装即 @p-jiangh/dsh-enhance）
```

预设由 bundle 的补丁层声明，**不是目录**：`cordis.patch.yml` 插入本插件行、**四条角色子预设**与 `preset-enhance` 行（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`）。profile 挂上本 bundle，**Enhance** 就出现在预设名册里；没有 `/presets install`、没有 `postinstall`，插件绝不在启动时写你的家目录。

`config.plugins` 就是该会话 agent 的**全部**构成（**没有继承**）：Enhance 预设里逐条写明了 persona（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 的 `prefix`，即 persona 正文）、`agent-instructions`（AGENTS.md 指令链）、工具行、四条受限子代理与 `@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance/enhance-mode` 段行。

> **为什么名册里还有 Scout / Librarian / Reviewer / Task（2026-10-19 起）**：dsh `0.2.1` 删除了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent` 的 `persona` 与 `toolFilter` 配置字段（宿主要求把人格与工具面写进 Agent 预设，再用 `agentPreset` 选择）。于是这四条角色组合各自成为一条真实预设：它们既被 `subagent_scout` / `subagent_librarian` / `subagent_reviewer` / `subagent_task` 四个工具使用，也可以被你自己直接选中（选中即得到一个窄工具面的会话：只读或可写）。宿主会把**每一条**注册的预设都列进名册，没有隐藏字段 —— 这是机制的直接后果，不是本插件"多出四个预设"。

> **兼容性（必须知道）**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 只存在于 **dsh ≥ 0.2.0** 的行式预设注册表里。老 CLI（如 nvm 里的 `0.1.0-rc.6`，其机制是已退役的目录式 `dsh-agent-presets`）解析不到这一行，它会成为 inactive entry（启动时给一条告警），**不是**静默生效；本插件不为此发明条件插入机制。
>
> **预设只在 Web / 桌面面可选**：提供 `agentPresets` 服务的是 Web 组合（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`）。因此**纯 headless / acp / sdk 的 profile** 启动时会为本插件的**五条预设行**各打印一条
> `preset-enhance… (@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset): pending (waiting for service: agentPresets)`——
> 这是上游那些预设行在等它们的服务，不是安装失败；插件本体在该 profile 里照常工作（工具、命令、work-rules 段都在），只是没有预设菜单可选。`pnpm qa:pack` 把"未激活的正好是这五条预设行"钉成已知项（多一条、少一条、或换别的行 pending 都会红），`pnpm qa:preset` 则在 Web 组合里断言这五条**都真的挂载成功**。
> 工作模式 C（Advisor 目标回归）需要 `preset-advisor` 与 `prompts/agents/advisor.persona.md`，**尚未实现**（见 `docs/modes.md` §5/§7）；当前 advisor 运行时是通过插件 Config 默认开启的伴随机制，不需要预设。

插件行接受一个 `config` 块——可在你的 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 或 home `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` 中覆盖：

```yaml
- id: dsh-enhance
  name: '@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance'
  config:
    workRules: |

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `workRules` | 内置纪律文案 | 提示词段文本；空字符串则移除该段 |
| `doctorTool` | `true` | 注册 `dsh_enhance_doctor` 工具 |
| `commands` | `true` | 注册人类指令 `/doctor`、`/boulder` 到 UI 指令表 |
| `guards` | `true` | 守卫钩子 + rules 注入器 + delivery-gate 的总开关 |
| `workTracking` | `true` | boulder 状态、写令牌、start-work / delivery-gate 钩子的总开关（目标是原生服务，不受此开关影响） |
| `worktree` | `true` | `worktree_create/list/cleanup` 工具（需要 workTracking） |
| `advisor` | `true` | Advisor 伴随审查运行时 |
| `advisorModel` | — | advisor 的独立审查模型；**只覆盖模型**，provider 仍继承主 agent 的路由 |

readme.section: 在界面里改（不用手写 YAML）
readme.text: 除 `workRules` 之外的 7 个字段都标了 `volatile()`，因此**内置「插件」面板**里本插件那一行会有一个「配置」入口：勾选/取消即时生效（写完立刻重建接线，不需要重启），改动落到你 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`user` 层），每行旁的「恢复默认」会把覆盖删掉、退回组合默认。

readme.section: 在界面里改（不用手写 YAML）
readme.text:
- 面板位置：侧边栏「插件」→ 找到 `@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance` 包 → 它那一行（设置弹窗里也有只读清单可查）。
- 一条纪律：**同一个字段只有一个写者**。用界面改了之后，就别再同时手工在补丁里写同一个键——界面会把你的覆盖读成 user 层，两边同时写会互相覆盖。
- 已知限制（上游）：非 loopback 的浏览器拿不到持久设置，页面会显示为只读/不可用；桌面端与 loopback Web 正常。
- 机制与真机证据（`describe`/`update` 往返、命名空间键、为什么必须重挂）：[docs/design-web-settings-card.md](docs/design-web-settings-card.md) §8–§10。

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build          # tsc → lib/
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test           # node --test

包是 ESM。**依赖规则**（改 manifest 前先读这条，它是有依据的约定而不是偏好）：

| 包 | 声明 | 为什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` | `dependencies` | 上游一等公民插件也这么声明。它是**纯数据**库：宿主用全局符号 `Symbol.for('schemastery')` 判定原生 schema（`dsh-app-boot` 的 `isNativeConfigSchema`），同版本的副本是安全的。 |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `peerDependencies`（optional） | 宿主就是 cordis，profile 永远不会去装它；我们只做**类型**导入，运行时不解析。 |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` | `peerDependencies`（optional） | 我们确实在运行时用它（`createUserMessage` / `BlockAssembler`），但它带**模块级身份**，一个 profile 里只能有宿主那一份。 |
| 其它 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` | 仅 `devDependencies` | 纯类型导入（构建时擦除），版本对齐宿主实际携带的 `0.2.0-rc.2`。 |

**绝不能**把服务类宿主包（`dsh-llm` / `dsh-agent` / `dsh-tools` / `cordis` …）写成 `dependencies`：那会在 profile 里 hoist 出第二份副本并**优先遮蔽**宿主那份，破坏模块级身份。宿主的运行时解析器本来就免费供给它们（`dsh-app-boot` 的 `createRuntimeResolution`：*"The runtime resolution supplies packages carried by the installation and selected bundles"*）。`pnpm qa:pack` 在**真 tarball 安装**上钉住了这条边界——仓库里的 `link:` 形态会掩盖它。
贡献者的工作纪律：先读 `AGENTS.md`；改动 prompts 或 roles 之前先查看 `docs/architecture.md` 与 `docs/roles.md`；persona 文本单源维护在 `prompts/agents/`（绝不手改生成的 `cordis.patch.yml`——字节锁定测试强制这一约定）。

- `AGENTS.md` — 如何在本仓库工作。
- `docs/architecture.md` — 架构与 M1–M8 里程碑计划。
- `docs/releasing.md` — **发布流程 runbook**（发布前必须全绿的门、打标签、Release 要点、明确不做的事）。
- `docs/value-assessment.md` — **存在价值评估**：逐面与上游原生能力对照，结论是把它定位为「政策包 + 验收脚手架」，长期应做减法而不是扩张。
- `docs/roles.md` — 6 角色智能体集。
- `docs/modes.md` — 三种工作模式（dsh-enhance 万能 / Planner 计划实施 / Advisor 目标回归）及它们如何编排这些角色。
- `docs/prompts-review/` — 逐提示词审查稿：persona/review 源 + 约束映射 + 规模校验 + 实驱状态。
- `docs/borrowing-analysis.md` — 从 MIT 生态（lazycodex、oh-my-pi）借用的模式及其落点。
- `docs/archive/` — 被取代/过时但保留作历史的文档。
**v1 的范围就是下面 M1–M6 加界面配置页**：一个装上去就能用的能力包（技能 / 提示词段 / 工具 / 命令 / 守门 / 工作追踪 / worktree / Enhance 预设 / 设置面）。M7 及以下未开工项是 **v2**，不是"v1 没做完"。

- **M1 ✅ 骨架**：`src/` 按能力目录重组；`prompts/agents/` 单源 + 生成 + 字节锁定；persona 预设落地。
- **M2 ✅ 提示词审查**：所有提示词经审查并中文化；采用 6 角色体系。
- **M3 ✅ 守卫 + delivery-gate**：write-existing/path-traversal/bash-read 守卫、rules-injector、delivery-gate 状态机 + verify 绑定 + 防篡改 + 完成报告。
- **M4 ✅ 工作追踪**：boulder（CAS、work 合并）、写令牌、start-work + delivery-gate 钩子。**goal 存储与 `goal_*` 工具已退役**（原生 `ctx.goals` 覆盖，见 `docs/value-assessment.md` §3）。
- **M5 ✅ worktree**：WorktreeManager（create/list/find/cleanup/reuse）、命名 + 路径校验、boulder 联动、worktree_create/list/cleanup 工具。
- **M6 ✅ enhance-mode**：深度工作协议改为 **Enhance 预设作用域内的常驻系统提示词段**（`@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance/enhance-mode`）；关键词触发（`ulw`/`ultrawork`）与目录式预设投递一并退役。
- **M7 LSP / comment-check（v2）**：计划中。
- **M8 团队模式（v2）**：**不建议自研**——上游已有 Agent Teams（成员 / 共享任务板 / 邮箱，见 `docs/value-assessment.md` §3）。
v2 候选（已定稿未开工，见 `docs/known-issues.md` 的 P3 表）：模式 B（Planner 预设）、模式 C（Advisor 预设）、delivery-gate 的 verify 模板库、UI 旗舰（Chat Node / turn-tail 状态条）、`playbooks/` 上手层、skills 池扩充、10 篇提示词的逐条实驱验证。

readme.section: What you will see after installing
readme.text:
A bundle is a **profile-level** plugin: it mounts when the profile starts and
**every session shares it**, so it is already active without picking a preset
(`dsh_enhance_doctor` reports "plugin loaded: yes").

readme.section: What you will see after installing
readme.text:
| You see | How to reach it | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| **Packaged skills** in the `/` menu | type `/`, or type `/tdd` directly — a typed skill name injects its body for that turn, deterministically | the bundle mounted |
| **This bundle's commands** `/doctor`, `/boulder` | type `/` and pick one (both take no arguments; Enter runs them) | `commands: true` (default) |
| **The `Enhance` preset** | pick it in the preset menu next to a new session's title, or set it as the default in settings | the bundle mounted (the preset row rides with it) |
| **Model-facing tools** `dsh_enhance_doctor`, `boulder_*`, `worktree_*` (goals use the native `create_goal` / `get_goal` / `update_goal`) | just let the model use them, or ask it to "run dsh_enhance_doctor" | the matching switch (all on by default) |
| **This bundle's settings page** | sidebar → Plugins panel → `@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance` → its row's config entry | desktop app or loopback Web (the browser half ships with the bundle) |

readme.section: What you will see after installing
readme.text:
- **A preset is fixed when the session is created.** Upstream refuses to switch a
  live session's preset (its history was produced under the previous tool
  surface). To try **Enhance**, create a new session; setting a new default only
  affects sessions created afterwards.
- **enhance-mode is not an instruction and not a trigger word** — it is a
  persistent prompt section scoped to the Enhance preset. The row-based preset
  registry requires **dsh ≥ 0.2.0** (see `docs/installing-plugins.md`).

You need the `dsh` CLI (npm: `@deepseek-ai/dsh`). **Replace `<your-profile>` with the
profile you actually run**: `desktop` for the desktop GUI, `web` for the loopback web
UI, `headless` for headless use.

```sh

readme.section: package name without scope symbols, then -<version>.tgz
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add \
  https://github.com/P-JIANGH/dsh-enhance/releases/download/v0.1.3/p-jiangh-dsh-enhance-0.1.3.tgz
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @p-jiangh/dsh-enhance

readme.section: 3) GitHub source (tracks master; the package builds itself through `prepare` — see the note below)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:P-JIANGH/dsh-enhance
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add ./path/to/dsh-enhance

readme.section: 5) a live link for debugging (points at your checkout; run `pnpm build` after src/ edits)
readme.text:
> **A wrong profile name is created silently.** `dsh plugin` creates a profile that
> does not exist, without complaining, so copying the example name verbatim installs
> the plugin into a profile the desktop app never loads — it looks installed and doesyaml
> allowBuilds:
>   "@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance@git+https://github.com/P-JIANGH/dsh-enhance.git#<commit>": true
> ```
> Prefer form 1 if that is annoying — the tarball already ships the built `lib/`.
>
> **Network**: on networks where `github.com` is not directly reachable, git can use a
> proxy scoped to GitHub only:sh
dsh --profile <your-profile> --dump-config   # look for a "# == " layer header; it carries the bundle name the profile records (@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance on a fresh install)
```

Presets are declared by the bundle's patch layer, **not** by a directory:
`cordis.patch.yml` inserts this bundle's plugin row, the **four role child
presets**, and the `preset-enhance` row (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset`). Mount
the bundle and **Enhance** appears in the roster. There is no `/presets install`,
no `postinstall`, and the plugin never writes to your home directory at startup.

`config.plugins` is the session agent's **entire** composition (**there is no
inheritance**): the Enhance preset lists its persona (a `prefix` — the persona
prose), `agent-instructions` (the AGENTS.md chain), tool rows, four scoped
subagents, and the `@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance/enhance-mode` row.

> **Why Scout / Librarian / Reviewer / Task are in the roster too (since
> 2026-10-19)**: dsh `0.2.1` deleted `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent`'s `persona`
> and `toolFilter` config fields — upstream now requires a role's persona and
> tool surface to live in an Agent Preset that the tool selects with
> `agentPreset`. Each role composition is therefore a real preset: the four
> `subagent_*` tools use them, and you can also select one directly (you get a
> narrow-tool session, read-only or writable). The host lists **every**
> registered preset and offers no hide field, so their presence is a direct
> consequence of that mechanism, not this bundle adding four presets.

> **Compatibility (important)**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` only exists in the
> **dsh ≥ 0.2.0** row-based preset registry. An old CLI (such as an nvm-installed
> `0.1.0-rc.6`, whose mechanism was the retired directory-based
> `dsh-agent-presets`) cannot resolve the row; it becomes an inactive entry (with
> a startup warning) rather than failing installation. This bundle deliberately
> does not invent a conditional-insert mechanism for that.
>
> **Presets are only selectable on the Web/desktop surface**: the `agentPresets`
> service comes from the Web composition (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`). A
> headless-only (or acp / sdk) profile therefore prints one line per preset row of
> ours at startup (five since 2026-10-19: Enhance plus the four role compositions) —
> `preset-enhance… (@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset): pending (waiting for service: agentPresets)`.
> That is upstream's preset row waiting for its service, **not an install
> failure**: the plugin itself works there (tools, commands and the work-rules
> section are all present), there is simply no preset menu. `pnpm qa:pack` pins
> the set of not-activated rows to exactly those five, and `pnpm qa:preset`
> asserts that all

The plugin row accepts a `config` block, overridable in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` or in `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-enhance
  name: '@p-jiangh/dsh-enhance'
  config:
    workRules: |

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `workRules` | built-in discipline text | prompt-section text; the empty string removes the section |
| `doctorTool` | `true` | register the `dsh_enhance_doctor` tool |
| `commands` | `true` | register the `/doctor` and `/boulder` human commands |
| `guards` | `true` | master switch for the guards, the rules injector and the delivery gate |
| `workTracking` | `true` | boulder state, write token, start-work / delivery-gate hooks (goals are native and unaffected) |
| `worktree` | `true` | the `worktree_*` tools (needs workTracking) |
| `advisor` | `true` | the advisor companion-review runtime |
| `advisorModel` | — | the advisor subagent's own model; inherits the main agent's route by default |

> Overriding a key means carrying `name` **and** every field you want to keep —
> a patch replaces the row's whole `config`; an omitted field falls back to its
> schema default.

readme.section: Editing in the UI instead of YAML
readme.text:
Every field except `workRules` is marked `volatile()`, so the built-in **Plugins**
panel gives this bundle's row a config entry: toggles apply as you save (the
wiring is rebuilt immediately, no restart), and the change lands in the user layer
of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Each row's reset removes that override and
falls back to the composed default.

readme.section: Editing in the UI instead of YAML
readme.text:
- One writer per field: after editing in the UI, do not also hand-write the same
  key in a patch — the UI reads your override as the user layer and the two will
  overwrite each other.
- Known upstream limitation: a non-loopback browser cannot hold persistent
  settings and shows the page read-only; the desktop app and loopback Web are fine.
- Mechanism and real-app evidence (a `describe` / `update` round trip, the
  namespace key, why the wiring must be remounted):
  `docs/design-web-settings-card.md` §8–§10.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build          # tsc → lib/
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test           # node --test

The package is ESM. **Dependency rule** (read this before touching the manifest —
it is an evidence-backed convention, not a preference):

| Package | Declared as | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` | `dependencies` | First-party dsh plugins declare it this way. It is a **pure data** library: the host recognises native schemas through the global `Symbol.for('schemastery')` (`dsh-app-boot`'s `isNativeConfigSchema`), so a same-version copy is safe. |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `peerDependencies` (optional) | The host *is* cordis; a profile never installs it, and we only import types. |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` | `peerDependencies` (optional) | We do use it at runtime (`createUserMessage` / `BlockAssembler`), but it carries **module-level identity**: one profile may hold only the host's copy. |
| Other `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` | `devDependencies` only | Type-only imports (erased at build), version-aligned with the host's `0.2.0-rc.2`. |

**Never** declare a service-class host package (`dsh-llm` / `dsh-agent` /
`dsh-tools` / `cordis` …) as a `dependencies` entry: that hoists a second copy
into the profile which then **shadows** the host's, breaking module-level identity.
The host's runtime resolver already supplies them for free — `dsh-app-boot`'s
`createRuntimeResolution`: *"The runtime resolution supplies packages carried by
the installation and selected bundles."* `pnpm qa:pack` pins that boundary on a
**real tarball install**, because the `link:` layout used by the rest of the test
suite hides it.

Contributor discipline: read `AGENTS.md` first; before touching prompts or roles
read `docs/architecture.md` and `docs/roles.md`; persona text is single-sourced in
`prompts/agents/` (never hand-edit the generated `cordis.patch.yml` — a byte-pin
test enforces this).

- `AGENTS.md` — how to work in this repository.
- `docs/architecture.md` — architecture and the M1–M8 plan.
- `docs/releasing.md` — the **release runbook** (the gates that must be green, tagging, Release notes, what v1 deliberately does not do).
- `docs/value-assessment.md` — **why this project exists**: each surface compared
  with the upstream native capability; the conclusion is to position it as a
  "policy package + acceptance scaffolding" and subtract rather than expand.
- `docs/roles.md` — the six-role agent set.
- `docs/modes.md` — the three working modes and how they orchestrate those roles.
- `docs/prompts-review/` — per-prompt review: source, constraint mapping, size
  checks, real-drive status.
- `docs/borrowing-analysis.md` — patterns borrowed from the MIT ecosystem.
- `docs/installing-plugins.md` — the full install / verify / configure / uninstall
  walkthrough, including the generic plugin mechanism.
- `docs/known-issues.md` — the ledger: what was measured, what changed, and why.

**v1 is exactly M1–M6 plus the settings page**: a capability package that works as
soon as it is installed. M7 and the other unstarted items below are **v2**, not
unfinished v1.

- **M1 ✅ Skeleton** — capability-directory layout, single-sourced personas, byte pins.
- **M2 ✅ Prompt review** — every prompt reviewed and localised; the six-role system.
- **M3 ✅ Guards + delivery gate** — guards, rules injector, gate state machine,
  bound `verify`, tamper resistance.
- **M4 ✅ Work tracking** — boulder (CAS), write token, start-work + gate hooks.
  Goal storage and the `goal_*` tools were **retired** (native `ctx.goals`).
- **M5 ✅ Worktrees** — manager (create / list / find / cleanup / reuse), naming
  and path validation, boulder linkage, the three tools.
- **M6 ✅ enhance-mode** — the deep-work contract became a **persistent prompt
  section scoped to the Enhance preset**; the keyword trigger and directory-based
  preset delivery were retired.
- **M7 LSP / comment-check (v2)** — planned.
- **M8 Team mode (v2)** — **not recommended to build**: upstream already ships
  Agent Teams (members, shared task board, mailbox).

v2 candidates (decided, not started): mode B (Planner preset), mode C (Advisor
preset), the delivery gate's `verify` template library, the UI flagship (Chat Node
/ turn-tail status bar), the `playbooks/` onboarding layer, a larger skills pool.
